headline: 7.4 magnitude quake: Tsunami warning issued after powerful tremor hits Mexico
summary: The earthquake struck near the coast of Chiapas, shaking buildings in Guatemala and El Salvador and prompting emergency evacuations.
details: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck near the coast of Mexico's southern state of Chiapas today, triggering a tsunami warning.
The US Geological Survey (USGS) reported that the quake occurred near the town of Puerto Madero at a shallow depth of 10 km (6 miles).
Following the tremor, the US Tsunami Warning System warned that hazardous tsunami waves were possible along coasts within 300 km (186 miles) of the epicenter.
In Guatemala City, the earthquake shook buildings and prompted residents to flee their homes. Local media showed staff evacuating a government building as security protocols were activated.
The tremor was also felt in neighboring El Salvador.
In the southern Mexican state of Oaxaca, Governor Salomon Jara stated that the earthquake was felt with moderate intensity in the capital, but no serious damage was immediately reported.
caption:
A massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake has hit the coast of Mexico, triggering a tsunami warning for nearby coastal areas.

A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck near the coast of Mexico's southern state of Chiapas today, triggering a tsunami warning.

The US Geological Survey (USGS) reported that the quake occurred near the town of Puerto Madero at a shallow depth of 10 km (6 miles).

Following the tremor, the US Tsunami Warning System warned that hazardous tsunami waves were possible along coasts within 300 km (186 miles) of the epicenter.

In Guatemala City, the earthquake shook buildings and prompted residents to flee their homes. Local media showed staff evacuating a government building as security protocols were activated.

The tremor was also felt in neighboring El Salvador.

In the southern Mexican state of Oaxaca, Governor Salomon Jara stated that the earthquake was felt with moderate intensity in the capital, but no serious damage was immediately reported.

headline_marked: Finance Minister, top leaders [[fall as stage collapses]] in Chattogram
headline: Finance Minister, top leaders fall as stage collapses in Chattogram
summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury and several MPs were unhurt after a crowded stage collapsed during a flood relief distribution event.
details: A stage collapsed during a flood relief distribution programme in Chattogram's Chandanaish upazila today, causing Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury and several other political leaders to fall.

The incident occurred at around 11:30am at Dohazari municipality. The collapse happened after an excessive number of local leaders, activists and guests climbed onto the structure shortly after the minister's arrival.
Among those who fell were Chattogram City Corporation Mayor Dr Shahadat Hossain, Chattogram-14 MP Jasim Uddin Ahmed, Patiya MP Enamul Haque and Boalkhali MP Ershad Ullah.
All leaders got up safely with no injuries reported. The relief distribution resumed shortly afterwards, with the finance minister and other officials continuing the programme.

Chandanaish Police Station sub-inspector Rupok Karmakar noted that the stage was not very high, which prevented a major accident. The situation returned to normal quickly despite some initial disorder.

The Chattogram district administration distributed relief to 250 families, and a local lawmaker provided assistance to another 2,000 families. Packages included 10kg of rice and 20kg of other essential food items.
